A '''house''' owned by [[Moxxar Krieg]] was located in the city of [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]], on the planet [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Krieg and [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Edvar Vang]] discovered the existence of a new kind of [[Syren spice|spice]].<ref name="SWG:MD" /> This spice was trafficked by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] but was also sought by the powerful criminal organization [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]].<ref name="SWG:MtYBF">{{SWGcite|exp=JtL|type=other}}Quest: "More than You Bargained For"</ref> Krieg decided to investigate the source of the spice but was finally assassinated.<ref name="SWG:MD" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> a group of spacers discovered a sample of the new spice while looking for a missing pilot, [[Cal Handro]]. They brought it to Doctor Vang but the latter exhorted them to interrogate Krieg instead of him. The spacers only found the corpse of Moxxar Krieg in his house.<ref name="SWG:MD" />

==Behind the scenes==
Moxxar Krieg's house was a location in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]].<ref name="SWG:MD" /> The game was shut down on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Moxxar Krieg's house was added to the game with the first chapter of the "[[W:c:swg:Secrets of the Syren|Secrets of the Syren]]" questline, released with the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 14 Notes for 9 March 05|Publish 14]]", on [[March 9]], [[2005]].<ref name="SonyForumsCite-Update Notes: Publish 14.0 - March 9, 2005">{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/board/message?board.id=swgpatchnotes&message.id=730|text=Update Notes: Publish 14.0 - March 9, 2005}}</ref> The "Secrets of the Syren" story arc was removed from the game with the "[[W:c:swg:Chapter 1|Chapter 1]]," published on [[June 8]], [[2006]], due to the major changes planed for Rori with the introduction of the [[Battle of Restuss]].<ref name="SonyCite-Chapter Archive 2006">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64186&resource=publish|text=Chapter Archive 2006}}</ref>
